notes.title: BIG UPDATE + BUG FIX
notes.notes:
There was a pretty nasty bug the past few days that affected quite a few games, and we now have  a fix live. If you've been experiencing an invisible shop, infinite currencies that you cannot use, and menus that aren't interactable, please update your game and put these troubles behind you. 😊



The new update also comes with some nifty features.

Waifu Shop now has a Shard Exchange Shop! Check under your Shop menu to turn in your dupes for new rewards - including Shard Dust exclusive new character, Celia!

All duplicate shards will now be automatically turned to Shard Dust.,

Check your craftable items again! The recipes now have lore.,

As mentioned above - Invisible Shops invisible no more! If your game has been buggy recently, it'll work fine again when you next launch it.



If you are having trouble updating (though the game should auto-update as soon as you start it), try this:
Right-click on Waifu Shop in your Steam Library menu > Properties > Installed Files > Verify integrity of game files. That'll sort you out for sure!
